analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read in FX evaluator due to using a channel-map offset without validating it against the current pixel layout. In ExecuteRPN (fU0/fU/fV paths), code reads p[pimg->channel_map[WHICH_NON_ATTR_CHAN].offset] (or pv[...] similarly). For expression '%[hex:u.intensity]', the parser routes through InterpretImageProperties->AcquireFxInfo/FxEvaluateChannelExpression with channel=Red/Green/Blue/Alpha, but the 'u.intensity' lookup causes WHICH_NON_ATTR_CHAN/ChannelQual handling to select an invalid offset for the image’s channel map, and ExecuteRPN dereferences beyond the allocated pixel channel map buffer.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger via LABEL coder property interpolation of a crafted filename/property string containing a braced FX/hex expression, e.g. '%[hex:u.intensity]'. Data flow: ReadLABELImage() passes image_info->filename to InterpretImageProperties(); 'hex:' invokes FxEvaluateChannelExpression multiple times; ExecuteRPN evaluates 'u.intensity' at (0,0) and performs unchecked channel_map offset indexing on current pixel data. Requires expression to reach fU0/fU-style channel read with mismatched/invalid channel qualifier so computed offset exceeds available channels, producing heap-buffer-overflow read.
